bridge.narrative: Qualcomm's June 24 roughly $3.92 billion acquisition of Modular pulls the largest neutral cross-vendor inference compiler off the board, reading explicitly as a strike at CUDA lock-in. That removal is the structural force the prediction names: once the dominant silicon-agnostic asset is captured, rival buyers face pressure to secure comparable runtime independence themselves.
bridge.remaining_gap: No rival buyer has yet announced a counter-acquisition of a comparable cross-vendor compiler or runtime startup.
